showroom.definition: An area where merchandise (such as cars) can be displayed.

service-center.definition: A facility where vehicles are inspected, maintained, or repaired by trained staff.
service-center.exampleUsage: The dealership's service center is behind the showroom.

parts-department.definition: A business division that provides replacement parts, often for vehicles or equipment.

finance-office.definition: The department responsible for managing a school or district’s funds, budgets, and financial records.

waiting-room.definition: A room where customers sit while waiting for service or an appointment.
waiting-room.exampleUsage: Customers can sit in the waiting room during maintenance.

detail-bay.definition: A work area where vehicles are thoroughly cleaned and cosmetically prepared.
detail-bay.exampleUsage: The new car was moved to the detail bay before delivery.

test-drive-route.definition: A planned road route used when a potential customer drives a vehicle for evaluation.
test-drive-route.exampleUsage: The salesperson explained the approved test-drive route to the licensed adult driver.

reception.definition: The manner in which something is greeted.

manager-s-office.definition: The private work room used by a manager.
manager-s-office.exampleUsage: The customer meeting continued in the manager's office.

test-drive.definition: A trial drive taken to determine whether a vehicle is safe and suitable to buy.

trade-in.definition: A used item, especially a vehicle, offered to a seller as part of the payment for another one.
trade-in.exampleUsage: The document shows the assessed value of the trade-in.

lease.definition: A contract granting use or occupation of property during a specified time for a specified payment.

down-payment.definition: The initial portion of an asset’s purchase price that a buyer pays, often stated as a percentage of the total cost, is called a down payment.

monthly-payment.definition: An amount of money due each month under a loan, lease, or payment agreement.
monthly-payment.exampleUsage: The finance sheet lists the estimated monthly payment.

msrp.definition: The manufacturer's suggested retail price for a product, especially a new vehicle.
msrp.exampleUsage: The window label shows the vehicle's MSRP.
msrp.arabicTranslation: سعر التجزئة المقترح من الشركة المصنعة

sticker-price.definition: The price printed on a product or catalog before any discounts are applied.

negotiation.definition: A discussion intended to produce an agreement.

certified-pre-owned.definition: Describing a used vehicle that has passed an inspection program and meets requirements set by a manufacturer or dealer program.
certified-pre-owned.exampleUsage: The brochure explains what the certified pre-owned program includes.

demo.definition: To give an exhibition of to an interested audience.

carfax.definition: A brand name associated with vehicle-history reports that summarize recorded information about used vehicles.
carfax.exampleUsage: The dealership showed a vehicle-history report from Carfax.

warranty.definition: A written assurance that some product or service will be provided or will meet certain specifications.

extended-warranty.definition: An agreement that provides specified repair or replacement coverage beyond a standard warranty period.
extended-warranty.exampleUsage: The contract explains what the extended warranty covers.

lemon-law.definition: A law that may give consumers remedies when a newly purchased vehicle has serious defects that cannot be fixed after reasonable attempts.
lemon-law.exampleUsage: The consumer guide explains the state's lemon-law protections.

sales-associate.definition: An employee who works with customers helps them choose, purchase, and understand the products or services a business offers.

finance-manager.definition: A dealership employee who handles financing documents, payment options, and related contracts.
finance-manager.exampleUsage: The finance manager reviewed the contract terms with the adult buyer.

technician.definition: A person who maintains and operates technical equipment during a production.

receptionist.definition: A secretary whose main duty is to answer the telephone and receive visitors.
